answer: Minting-cost proof-of-work resists sybils: each new identity must burn real CPU to mine its key, earned slow as copper patina, never handed free. One honest account pays once; a swarm of a thousand fakes pays a thousand separate computations that split its budget like a prism. The slash of cost is a clear signal, so the toll climbs with head count and cheap mass registration stalls against compounding compute no shortcut can fake.
